title: Additional slave instances assign their base pointer to the master
summary: Additional-instance creation at indigo_driver.c:1830-1865 sets additional_device->base_device to slave_device instead of setting additional_slave_device. This corrupts cloned master/slave identity. Next: set the cloned slave base, preserve master base and cover one-master/one-slave create/enumerate/remove/recreate with private-data ownership assertions. Source-confirmed, no device lifecycle executed.
